newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq slips amid concern over rising bond yields.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq slips amid concern over rising bond yields.

text.p: Concern over rising bond yields pushed down Nasdaq shares Friday, traders said.
The Nasdaq Composite Index lost 14.55 points to close unofficially at 1363.82 on volume of 713 million shares.
The index is down from its record high of 1400.53, reached Jan 23.
Traders said bond yields approaching seven percent prompted profit taking Friday. They also said they are waiting for next week's employment data, which if strong could send interest rates higher.
Higher yields would make bonds an attractive alternative tostocks. The 30-year Treasury bond yeilded 6.89 percent in late trading Friday.

The Dow Jones Industrial Average fell Friday amid concern about the market's near-term outlook and mounting interest rate pressure. It closed down 59.27 points at 6696.48 after being down more than 90 points earlier in the day.
For the week, the Dow lost more than 200 points.
Among Nasdaq stocks that lost ground were Cascade Communications Corp, which plunged 23-1/8 to 41 after the companywarned of slowing revenue growth.
Other losers were Intel Corp, which fell 1-1/4 to 150-1/2, Cisco Systems Inc, which fell 3-1/8 to 68-5/8, and Oracle Corp, which slipped 7/8 to 39-5/8.
